scope: Clipboard storage admission, explicit unreadable-history recovery and utility picker panel dismissal.
changes: Clipboard history validates bounded regular-file reads, record identities and exact owned image paths.
Serialized admission and atomic replacement use the same encoded bytes; oversized individual offers preserve previous entries.
Capture validates old history before writing an image, and failed history replacement removes newly staged images while preserving committed bytes.
Unreadable history offers explicit reset or cancellation; cancellation preserves saved history and images.
Selected images are revalidated as bounded owned bytes after picker exit, before copying.
Shared pickers and accepted menu routes request desktop-owned shell dismissal before launch; failures prevent picker or action dispatch.
Installed capture commands, trusted configured actions and literal provider arguments retain their existing owners.

full_python_suite.execution: Rerun with permission for owned temporary Unix-socket fixtures; no live desktop or clipboard commands.

original_sandbox_attempt.limitation: AF_UNIX fixture binds were denied in existing artifact-retirement and multi-output cleanup tests. The failed initial attempt remains recorded separately from the passing rerun.

coverage: Exact serialized boundary, sole Unicode/escaped offers, aggregate/count eviction, deduplication, sensitivity hints and concurrent writers.
Malformed JSON/schema, lone surrogate, oversized files, invalid UTF-8, symlinks, FIFO, private permissions and image identity checks.
Read/replace/fsync failures preserve committed bytes and clean owned temporary files or newly staged images.
Recovery cancellation/reset/failure, literal text/image copying, stale image selection and copy failure before typing.
Hide-before-picker and direct capture action, dismissal failures, compatibility toggling, nonopening routes and rollback to stock.

hosted_check.visual_scope: This source predates the reviewed notification/media/system baseline updates; consolidated rerun remains pending.
